name: Dipesh
expectations: Days 1–7: 1.5–2.5 kg (mostly water from cutting salt, sugar, refined carbs)
Days 8–30: 0.5–1 kg per week of real fat loss
Keep the routine after Day 30 — 10 kg is realistic in 2.5–3 months
rules: No added sugar — no sugar in tea, no mithai, no cold drinks or packaged juice
No fried food — samosa, puri, pakora, namkeen, chips, fried litti
Less salt — no pickle or papad
safety: Stop the walk and eat something if you feel dizzy, faint, have chest pain, or a racing heart. See a doctor if it happens again.
